title: Just When I Need Him Most
lyrics: Verse 1:
[C]Just when I need Him, [G7]Jesus is [C]near,
[F]Just when I falter, [C]just when I [G]fear;
[G7]Ready to help me, [C]ready [F]to [C]cheer,
[F]Just when I [C]need [G7]Him [C]most.
Refrain:
[F]Just when I need Him most,
[C]Just when I need Him most,
[D]Jesus is [D7]near to [G]comfort and [G7]cheer,
[F]Just when I [C]need [G7]Him [C]most.
Verse 2:
Just when I need Him, Jesus is true,
Never forsaking, all the way through,
Giving for burdens pleasures anew,
Just when I need Him most.
Refrain:
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.
Verse 3:
Just when I need Him, Jesus is strong,
Bearing my burdens all the day long;
For all my sorrow giving a song,
Just when I need Him most.
Refrain:
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.
Verse 4:
Just when I need Him, He is my all,
Answering when upon Him I call;
Tenderly watching lest I should fall,
Just when I need Him most.
Refrain:
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.
